status: Follow-up proposed after observing primary fixed .5 collapse and AUROC. Never evidence of a fresh domain or a preregistered primary win.
sources: All 48 published primary-sealed weights and splits; do not refit body. Fit calibrators only on original dev examples. Fix every calibrator as a single seal before replaying scores on the same test rows.
threshold: Maximize dev balanced accuracy across distinct adjacent probability midpoints and outside endpoints, ties closest to .5 then lowest. Keep raw p for Brier; report classification-only impact.
platt: Fit monotone logistic slope on standardized dev logits, bias free, soft labels absent; slope [0,30], bias [-30,30], fixed ridge on slope.
comparators: Apply both interventions to every physical and conventional comparator using identical development windows. For each arm across seeds preserve raw/dev/holdout probabilities, chosen thresholds and affine calibrator.
